decisions_requested.statement: Approve [WORKPLACE_OR_WORK_LOCATION] as the response schema, with VALIVAN/TAYOVAN as governed example anchors only.
Approve [STUDY_LOCATION_OR_SCHOOL_DOMAIN] as the response schema, with PARAZAMO/PAROVAN as governed example anchors only.
Approve [GOVERNED_STUDY_CONTENT_OR_WORK_ACTIVITY] as an open semantic response schema bounded to governed inventory; do not create a lexeme merely to provide an example.
Approve branch-specific controlled response schemas for perception/time examples while keeping the OPI-006 travel yes/no response branch BLOCKED.
Confirm answer schemas are pedagogical response contracts and do not establish full declarative HNK sentence syntax, copular grammar or word order.
Do not invent yes/no particles, travel-response syntax, new lexical forms or meanings to complete the Q&A lane.
Keep WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN authority labels unchanged and keep VANI/VANUVALI unresolved and excluded.
If all answer schemas are approved, authorize preparation of one SQS authoring gate for the full 16-slot block, with OPI-006 unavailable as a Q&A answer branch until separately governed.
